column1: # mapping_set_title: "NABON Informatiestandaard borstkanker (2020-11-12) -> ECCDM element crosswalk"

# comment: "Direction: subject (NABON) <predicate> object (ECCDM hub). Non-standard ext cols: subject_terminology (deferred, blank), source_context (NABON MDO phase: preoperatief|postoperatief|neoadjuvant|metastase|recidief), element_kind, mapping_cardinality, review_status. DURCHSTICH = model CancerConditionAtDiagnosis. source_context resolves the pre/post-op n:1 collisions: rows with the SAME object_id MUST differ in source_context. postoperatief rows are kept to surface a hub limitation (ECCDM collapses pre/post-op pathology into one field)."

column13: comment
Preoperativer histolog. Typ (op biopt) = Erstdiagnose-Aequivalent. Weitere Splits: Modalitaet (Morfologie echo/mammo/MRI 653/655/656).

KOLLISION mit -850 auf dasselbe Hub-Feld, aufgeloest via source_context. Postoperativer (definitiver OP-Pathologie-)Typ. ECCDM hat KEIN separates post-OP-Pathologie-Feld -> Hub kann pre/post nicht unterscheiden (Informationsverlust, Hub-Limitation).
NABON Quadrant-Lokalisation feiner (+ Zijde/dataelement-10 fuer Lateralitaet). Hub bodySite = 1 CodeableConcept -> Quadrant+Zijde zusammenfuehren.

Invasief = Nottingham/BRE (Bloom-Richardson-Elston, Grad 1/2/3, Waardelijst Mamma_Graad_ICO3). tumourGradeSystem hat KEIN NABON-Feld -> System steckt IMPLIZIT im Feldnamen (invasief=Nottingham) statt explizit. Genau warum ECCDM System+Wert trennt.
KOLLISION mit -17, aufgeloest via source_context. Postoperativer Nottingham-Grad. Wie bei Type tumor: ECCDM kann pre/post nicht trennen.
Direct date match; NABON patient DOB = hub birthDate. Vague date (year-only) supported by both.

GeslachtBiologisch codelist (2015); biological sex at birth. Pair with dataelement-534 (administrative Geslacht) → observedSexGender. GAP: comorbiditiesAtCancerDiagnosis — no coded comorbidity list in NABON; voorgeschiedenis(542) is free text only.
Administrative gender (GeslachtCodelijst 2017); maps to observedSexGender rather than sexAtBirth since not explicitly biological.

NABON packs composite TNM string into one field; hub has per-component backbone (one stage.value per T/N/M axis). broadMatch: cTNM broader than single stage.value entry. Individual cT(27), cN(29), M(388) available but all collapse to same hub slot. CancerStage.classificationType and .type are GAPs: NABON encodes staging type implicitly via field-naming prefix (c/p/yc/yp), not as an explicit element.
Postoperative pathological composite TNM (SNOMED 106249008). Same composite→per-component limitation as cTNM row. Individual pT(26), pN(30), pN_oksel(643), pN_schildwacht(644) available.

Interim clinical TNM during/after neoadjuvant chemotherapy (SNOMED 106248000). ypTNM(564/634) — post-NAC+surgery pathological — also neoadjuvant context and would collide on source_context; covered by comment only. Individual ycT(458), ycN(459), ypT(563), ypN(562) available.
T-stage of recurrence (SNOMED 78873005). Only recidief-context TNM component with a distinct source_context slot; rN absent in NABON.

Breast quadrant of primary lesion serves as Surgery.bodySite for breast conserving surgery / mastectomy. Combine with Zijde(10) for full laterality+quadrant. GAP: Surgery.date (no surgery date in NABON), Surgery.intent (no explicit curative/palliative flag). Hub lacks Surgery.type: Operatie tumor(32), Operatie lymfeklieren(28), Reconstructie(33) are rich NABON procedure-type fields without hub target.
Coded RT location (Mamma_Lokatie_Radiotherapie: breast/axilla/IMN/supraclav etc.); direct match to Radiotherapy.bodySite. GAP: Radiotherapy.intent, startDate, endDate not captured in NABON.

Hyperthermia adjunct to RT; NABON records yes/no boolean. Hub setting expects coded RT modality/setting (e.g. adjuvant/palliative). Weak match: hyperthermia is a technique modifier, not a setting concept.
Adjuvant systemic treatment type (chemo/hormonal/targeted/immunotherapy; SNOMED 416608005). Recommended in postop MDO. SystemicTreatment.startDate, endDate, ongoing are GAPs in NABON.
Neoadjuvant therapy type (Mamma_Therapie codelist). n:1 with dataelement-440 resolved via source_context (neoadjuvant vs postoperatief).
Palliative systemic therapy options for metastatic breast cancer (Mamma_Palliatieve_Therapie codelist). n:1 with 440/748 resolved via source_context.
Yes/no flag for whether neoadjuvant treatment was given; loosely maps to SystemicTreatment.setting (CodeableConcept). Binary flag vs coded setting concept.
Line of treatment (1st/2nd/3rd etc.; SNOMED 362961001); maps to setting in palliative/metastatic context. n:1 with dataelement-558 resolved via source_context.
Coded metastatic sites (SNOMED 258331007); direct hub match. Toelichting metastasen(403) provides narrative supplement.
Location of locoregional recurrence (SNOMED 314955001); direct match. Resectabiliteit recidief(448) supplements. tumourGradeValue is a GAP: NABON does not reassess grade at recurrence.
Treatment response codes (CR/PR/SD/PD; SNOMED 118208006) approximate disease status in metastatic setting. Hub diseaseStatus broader. assertedDate GAP: Datum MDO(539) is weak proxy only.
Type of recurrence lesion (local/regional/distant; Mamma_Recidief_Aanwezig codelist); maps to hub extentType. NABON recidief context.

Pathological response to NAC on surgical specimen (SNOMED 118208006); close match to treatmentResponseType. PA-respons lymfeklieren(786) is complementary lymph node response. treatmentResponseType.date is a GAP.
Clinical/imaging response of tumor to NAC (interim MDO assessment; SNOMED 118208006). Less definitive than PA-respons(638). n:1 source_context: neoadjuvant (interim) vs postoperatief (final PA).
Treatment response in metastatic setting. 1:n fan-out: same NABON element also maps to ClinicalCancerProgression.diseaseStatus (different object_id).
Direct date match; death date of patient. Vague date (year-only) supported.

Boolean death indicator → hub vitalStatus CodeableConcept (alive/dead/unknown). Boolean→coded conversion required. GAP: causeOfDeath not recorded in NABON. LastFollowUp.date GAP: no explicit follow-up date field in NABON.
Coded follow-up plan/result (Mamma_Follow-up codelist); may implicitly encode disease evidence but is not a direct boolean evidenceOfDisease equivalent.

Imaging type (SNOMED 360037004: mammography/echography/MRI/PET-CT). NABON records modality per exam separately (mammografie(674), echografie(677), MRI morphologie(656)) — hub Imaging.type = single CodeableConcept → n:1 fan-in.
Imaging modality for ycN staging during/after neoadjuvant therapy (SNOMED 360037004). n:1 with dataelement-391 resolved via source_context.
Post-NAC imaging evaluation type (Mamma_BeeldvormendOnderzoek_v2 codelist); maps to Imaging.type in post-NAC assessment context. n:1 resolved via source_context.

Breast quadrant of imaged lesion (SNOMED 272670002); narrowMatch to Imaging.bodySite. NABON imaging strongly breast-specific with rich detail (BI-RADS(31), massa(663), echogeniciteit(766) etc.) — imaging finding/result elements are GAPs in hub. ActiveSurveillance: all 4 elements unmapped — NABON is breast-treatment-oriented MDO workflow with no active surveillance protocol elements (start/end surveillance period); complete GAP.
